items.description: Roundwood input per m3 of sawnwood output, coniferous, New Zealand (national questionnaire factor, all sawnwood states)
items.note: Table row 'CONIFER  Sawnwood all  m3rw/m3p ... 1.81' in the New Zealand (Oceania) column, the last value in the row; implies about 0.55 m3 sawnwood per m3 log (derived 1/1.81 = 0.552). The text quotes Germany 1.59 and the United States of America 2.04 m3 roundwood per m3 sawnwood for comparison. Position-based column assignment from a wide PDF table; verify. Read from a wide PDF table by column position; confirm against the PDF before any test gates on it.

items.description: Sawmill material balance, coniferous logs, North America (Canada and United States median/average): shares of log volume going to sawnwood, chips/slabs, sawdust, shavings and shrinkage
items.note: FAO/ITTO/UN (2020) section 4.4.1, p. 26, CONIFER 'Material balance' rows, North America Median/Average column: Sawnwood 47, Chips/slabs 33, Sawdust 9, Shavings 8, Shrinkage loss 3 (read from the rendered PDF page, 2026-10-23). New Zealand reports only 'Sawnwood all' 1.81 m3rw/m3p and no material balance, so an earlier version of this item mislabelled these North American shares as New Zealand's. Use as a stand-in for a New Zealand mill until a New Zealand balance is cited.

items.description: Element areas of a single-storey NZS 3604 timber reference house (Waikato, consented design) and area per m2 of gross internal floor area
items.note: Table 2-2: 'Roof ... 263', 'Envelope wall ... 156', 'Internal walls Timber frame (90x45mm) with 10mm plasterboard lining on both sides 169', 'Windows and exterior doors ... 36', 'Floor Concrete slab on grade (100mm thick, 17.5 MPa) ... 209', 'Gross internal area 209', 'Gross floor area 218'. Per-m2 columns are derived (area / 209). The house includes a double garage; 'Building Lifespan 90', 'GFA Approx. 194', 'NLA 156' appear in the building summary.

items.description: Concrete in a slab-on-grade floor per m2 of floor, from the reference house slab thickness
items.note: Derived: floor 'Concrete slab on grade (100mm thick, 17.5 MPa)' over 209 m2 = 20.9 m3 for the slab, i.e. 0.1 m3 per m2; excludes footings and thickenings.

items.description: Timber framing ratio (framing area as share of wall area) for light timber-framed wall assemblies
items.note: Table 6-2: 'Timber-framed, cavity, 90 mm frame studs @ 400 mm centres, dwangs 800 mm centres (18% framing ratio)'; steel-framed assemblies use 14.4%. Framing volume per m2 of floor was not stated in any source read.
